title: Page 216
transc:
Capt JG Van Duzer  Washn Nov 1st 1864
Florence plunge Lantern zodiac Moscow was directed
some days ago to send you Maynards
quincy He is also directed to send
you all nugget Whisky in Geneva &
vicinity zebra Japan has sent his Borgia
Shelby Rawlins to Gaul to hurry forward
these webb should you want them to
land at Clifton or Garter or Embrace
instead of ripley port please so direct
The pension Alpha whips had all gotten
off blithe harrow penny ultimo & the 
peach from Abner stomach the harsh pension
and harrow postpone unity Theres another wharton
in Abner which wilby gotten off persia
completed stop The plank whips saxon torrent
wilson are enroute but as they had
a long march before reaching weldon or
weasel boat whig we may not hear
of them for some days I think
you should plant all you can against
Handle replacing the garrisons in your watkins
by new whisky as they arrive Jacob
